label: Invented person; not user research

steps.note: Screen 1: big RED 'IPMA warning in force in Lisbon now', rain to 18:00, orange wind to 21:00. 'Web Summit' only in the eyebrow at 111 px.
Screen 2: 'Closed or suspended today', Web Summit one link among eight at 1053 px, with 'read Tue 20:59'.
Tap jumps to 8364 px: card 'Day 2 (Wednesday 11 Nov) will not take place' at 8648 px. Answer found, orientation lost. Scrolling instead reaches 'THE DECISION FACT' at 1593 px (screen 3).
First story 'How Web Summit's Day 2 was called off' at 597 px.
Screen 1 is file/API links (522-894 px); first narrative heading at 1231 px. Gives up.
Looks for whether people are OK: nothing on injuries, attendees or damage; only a homeless contingency plan at 11093 px.

understood_10s: There is a red rain warning in Lisbon now, orange wind; nothing yet on whether Web Summit is on.
understood_1min: Web Summit Day 2 (Wednesday) is called off on the government's advice; Day 3 (Thursday) aims to proceed; schools, tunnels, coaches and some trains closed; metro and buses said they would run.

looked_for.where: / at 1593 px (screen 3), or the 'Web Summit' link at 1053 px to a card at 8648 px
/ screen 1 (red rain, orange wind) and screen 2 (closures)
nothing on /, /stories/ or the Day 2 story

lost: The 'Web Summit' link at 1053 px jumps 7311 px down into a card list with no way back up.
'read Tue 20:59' beside today's closures made him doubt the information was still current.
The Day 2 story opens with a screen of JSON/CAP/API links before any narrative.
Ten-item navigation plus version, Repo and Panel: unclear which is 'the news'.
would_act: Would share a link whose first screen says 'Web Summit: Wednesday cancelled, Thursday aims to go ahead' with a time; would come back tomorrow morning if he knew it would say first whether Day 3 is on.
score_reason: The weather is unmistakable in five seconds, but the summit answer waits on screen 3 and 'are people OK' is not answered anywhere he looked.

findings.what: Summit decision below the fold on a page whose title band says Web Summit
findings.measure: eyebrow 'Web Summit' at 111 px; decision text at 1593 px (screen 3 of 664 px)
findings.change: One line in screen 1 under the date: 'Web Summit: Day 2 (Wed) called off; Day 3 (Thu) aims to proceed', with source and time, linking to the decision.

findings.what: No answer, and no 'nothing reported' line, on whether people are OK
findings.measure: no injuries/casualties/occurrences found in 0-9553 px of /; only a homeless plan at 11093 px
findings.change: Primary-source occurrence counts if published (e.g. ANEPC), labelled; otherwise state the absence ('no figures on injuries or damage read yet'), no advice of our own.

findings.what: 'Web Summit' link in the closures paragraph jumps far down with no way back
findings.change: Show the one-line decision inline or expand in place; add 'back to top' on cards.

findings.what: 'read Tue 20:59' beside today's closures reads as stale
findings.change: Lead with 'announced Tue 19:09'; keep 'read' times in the detail card.

findings.what: Story opens with file and API links before the narrative
findings.measure: source links 522-894 px; first narrative heading 1231 px
findings.change: Move the source block below the first section on phone widths.

findings.what: Unglossed jargon in the first screens
findings.measure: IPMA/ANEPC at 76 px, Comunicado nº2 at 351 px; 'UTC = Lisbon' only at ~2100 px
findings.change: Gloss on first use (Portugal's weather service, civil protection); put 'UTC = Lisbon time' beside the date at 111 px.

findings.what: Ten-item navigation plus Repo, Panel and version on a phone
findings.change: Seen, not judged: serves other personas.
